rngDefinition: SHA256 of ordered actual post-draw RNG states, including seed hash/state/call count for every fromSeed/fork/import instance; prototype observation makes no extra draws. Batches of 8192 preserve exact call order.
definition: Full canonical/actual RNG hashes include all fields and statistics; repeated public counters/support/ledgers are represented once per CPU reference and checked by hashes for every variant.
